name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  intro x
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, List.mem_append]
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append] <;>
    try exact Or.inl
  all_goals
    try (split <;> (try split) <;>
      simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append] <;>
      (try exact Or.inl) <;> (try exact Or.inr))
  all_goals repeat' (first | assumption |
    refine or_or_distrib_right.mpr ∘ Or.imp ?_ ?_)

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  refine List.Sublist.subset ?_
  induction h
  case abs ih => assumption
  case quant ih₁ ih₂ | eq ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.append ih₂
  case ite ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact (ih₁.append ih₂).append ih₃
  case app hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact List.Sublist.refl _
    · next hfalse =>
      exfalso
      cases hn .oldPred
      apply hfalse <;> rfl
    · exact ihfn.append ihe
  all_goals exact List.nil_sublist _

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hn := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength hi)
    hn (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  simp only [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  refine Eq.ndrec
    (updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength hu)
      (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))) (updatedStatesComm ?_).symm
  simp only [List.unzip_zip (UpdateStatesLength hu), List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength hi)]
  intro k hk hk'
  simpa [hn k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined' hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  have hc :=
    Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  have hp :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx)
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hcomp, hdiff, hrange, hφx⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤) ((isOpen_Ioi.preimage hc).mem_nhds hp)
  have hpositive :=
    (hdiff.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ)
      hcomp.mul_right (fun y => by
        by_cases hy : φ y = 0
        · simp [hy]
        · exact mul_nonneg (hrange ⟨y, rfl⟩).1 (hs (subset_tsupport φ hy)).le)
      (mul_ne_zero (hφx.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hp.ne')
  apply hpositive.ne'
  simpa only [inner_smul_right', Pi.mul_apply] using hg (fun y => φ y • f x)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hdiff, hcomp⟩ contDiff_const)

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hEs (j : Fin d) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) (n := 2) hA3 t
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBm (j : Fin d) := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) (n := 2) A hA3 (j, i)
  have hBt (j : Fin d) := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hBm j) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)] at hg
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, div_eq_mul_inv,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt,
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hg
  simp only [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA2 x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hBm j)]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hA2]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i),
      Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_sub, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, mul_one]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let f := (mulLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c)).compr₂
    (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF)
  let g := mulLinearMap.compr₂
    (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ c ∘ₗ timeOrderF)
  change f a b = g a b
  suffices h : f = g from LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h a b
  refine ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun xs => ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun ys => ?_
  simp only [f, g, c, LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    mulLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let s := (xs ++ ys).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
  let p := fun z => crAnTimeOrderRel φ z ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel z φ
  let l1 := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      s ++
    List.filter p xs))
  let l2 := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter p ys ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      s))
  have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, p c) :
      ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (xs ++ l ++ ys))) =
      l1 * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * l2 := by
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ xs l ys hl]
    simp only [l1, l2, s, p, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (xs ++ φ :: ψ :: ys) •
    (l1 * ι c * l2)
  · simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF, ofList_singleton,
      mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
      map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [p, hφψ, hψφ]), hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [p, hφψ, hψφ])]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
    rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
  have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
  simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at h0
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
    (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc, ← h0]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
      hq.symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
    simp only [map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul,
      Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  · simp only [map_mul, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case app l r il ir =>
    cases il rfl l <;>
      grind only [→ canonical_form_abs, → Red.abs,
        → Red.appᵣ, → Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1]
  case' tapp =>
    cases der'.wf.2.1
  case let' =>
    grind only [(body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1).2, → Red.let_body, → Red.let_bind]
  case case =>
    obtain ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1
    grind only [→ canonical_form_sum,
      → (Red.case · b₂ b₃), → (Red.case_inl · b₂ b₃), → (Red.case_inr · b₂ b₃)]
  all_goals grind only [der'.wf.2.1, Value,
    → Red.inl, → Red.inr, → canonical_form_tabs, → Red.tabs, → Red.tapp]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par iha ihb a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
    obtain ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := iha ha''
    obtain ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := ihb hb''
    exact ⟨_, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par => apply symm
  case par.red_I hb' ihb ha' iha | red_I.par ha' hb' =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha'
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb'⟩
  case par.red_K ha' iha | red_K.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨a₂', ha, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha'
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., ha⟩
  case par.red_S hb' ihb a c ha' iha | red_S.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨a'', c', ha, hc, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha'
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par ha hb') (.par hc hb')⟩
  all_goals exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨ChoiceBisim, .choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · grind only [ChoiceBisim, → Bisimilarity.symm]
  · intro a b hr μ t ht
    cases hr <;> rename_i h
    case' choice =>
      cases ht
      case choiceR ht => exact ⟨t, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      exact (h.follow_fst ‹_›).imp fun u hb =>
        ⟨by apply_rules only [hb.1, Tr.choiceL], .bisim hb.2⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hmem⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let D := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let K := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i.castSucc steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩ steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ D.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    let B := {x // f x ≠ g x}
    let J : B → D × Fin (2 ^ steps) := fun x =>
      (⟨Q x.val, ⟨x.val, rfl, x.property⟩⟩, K x.val)
    have hrec (x) : F (Q x) (K x) = x :=
      (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (Q x)).mp rfl
    have hj : Function.Injective J := fun x y h =>
      Subtype.ext ((hrec x.val).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun p : D × Fin (2 ^ steps) => F p.1.val p.2) h).trans (hrec y.val)))
    have hc := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective J hj
    have hB : Nat.card B = hammingDist f g :=
      (Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := B)).trans (Fintype.card_subtype _)
    rwa [hB, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_fin] at hc
  have hfw : 2 * D.ncard ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) -
      2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) :=
    le_of_eq_of_le (congrArg (2 * ·) hg)
      (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt))
  have ht := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hfw
  rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.sub_add_eq, Nat.pow_sub_mul_pow 2
      (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    Nat.sub_add_eq, Nat.pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at ht
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ :=
    Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans
      (by rw [←mul_assoc]; exact ht))
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hmem) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr hn

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  have ha (a b u v s t : L) :
      (a + u * b) * (s * v - t) + (a + v * b) * (t - s * u) =
        (a * s + b * t) * (v - u) := by ring
  rw [ha, hd, mul_one]
  simp only [P', c, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  intro ϑ hϑ
  induction ϑ, hϑ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    intro u hp
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (u := u),
      prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (P := fun r =>
      Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u := by
      funext i
      match i with
      | 0 => rfl
      | 1 => rfl
    exact hu ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
  | succ n hn ih =>
    intro u hp
    simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u)] at hp
    have hs := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
      (P := multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (MC := MC) u e)
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (C := MC) u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) u e (hs ▸ hp))
    apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
    intro r hr
    classical
    exact ih _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let v n : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u n, hB n⟩
  let f n := (v n, v (n + 1), v (n + 2), v (n + 3))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (fun n => Set.mem_univ (f n))
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hij.le
  have hs : ∀ n ≥ i, f (n + c) = f n := Nat.le_induction h.symm fun n hn ih => by
    rw [Nat.add_right_comm]
    simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.ext_iff, v] at ih ⊢
    refine ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ) ?_⟩
    erw [(hu (n + c + 4) (Nat.le_add_left ..)).1, (hu (n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left ..)).1]
    simp only [Nat.reduceSubDiff, ih]
  exact ⟨i, c, Nat.pos_of_lt_add_right hij, fun n hn => congrArg (Subtype.val ∘ Prod.fst) (hs n hn)⟩

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [ne_eq, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero 2, ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP).1
  intro Q hQ hPQ
  apply hPQ.antisymm
  intro A hA
  by_contra hn
  exact hPS ⟨A, hn, fun U hU => hQ hA (hPQ hU)⟩

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i)   := by
  have step (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (hab : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    convert ((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i using 1
    symm
    apply eq_add_of_sub_eq
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f h
  have hd := step d e h.1
  have he := step e f h.2
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hs
  intro i
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  convert dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_add (hd i) (he i)))
    (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)) using 1 <;> ring
